Fixtures for `tests/orchestrator/tracker-config.test.mjs` and `tests/tracker-config.bats`, which
run both tracker-config readers on them.

- `issue-tracker-github.md` — this repo's `.coding-crew/docs/issue-tracker.md` (front matter `tracker: github`)
- `issue-tracker-no-front-matter.md` — this repo's `.coding-crew/docs/templates/trackers/local.md` (no front matter)
- `config-afk-only.json` — this repo's `.coding-crew/config.json` before it had a `tracker` section
